add_hints.py.summary: Add simple type hints to Python files in place with LibCST.
details: Infers the parameter and return types from the literal defaults and the returns, optionally also from the parameter names (``name`` -> ``str``, ``count`` -> ``int`` ...), validates every result by parsing it and offers ``--dry-run``, ``--diff``, ``--backup`` and ``--no-returns``.

addel.py.summary: Report the files added or removed in every commit of a git repository.
details: Walks the revision range (HEAD by default) with ``git diff-tree`` or by checking out each commit, explodes the renames into a removal plus an addition, cross-checks the result against the working tree and renders a text, JSON, CSV or Markdown ledger.

addmainguard.py.summary: Detect and add ``if __name__ == "__main__":`` guards to Python files.
details: The ``check`` subcommand reports the files without a guard, ``fix`` either moves the top-level code into a ``main()`` (``--strategy ast``) or appends the guard with a placeholder ``main()`` (``--strategy template``); ``--exclude``, ``--dry-run`` and ``--indent`` tune the run.

afkco.py.summary: Detect and optionally remove the unused imports of Python files.
details: Collects the imported names with ast, compares them with the names actually used, also reads the Python members of wheels and ``.tar.zst`` archives, and can rewrite the files in place with ``--autofix`` (``--dry-run`` previews, ``--exclude`` filters, ``--verbose`` adds the per-name detail).

afkx.py.summary: Detect and remove unused imports with the built-in analyzer or autoflake.
details: Similar to :doc:`afkco`, plus ``--autoflake`` to delegate the rewrite to the external autoflake tool with a ``--diff`` preview; archives (wheel, tar.zst) are analysed without being unpacked.

aitrans.py.summary: Translate text files in place with an AI model.
details: Collects the files of the requested extensions (``txt`` and ``md`` by default), translates each one with the OpenAI client and falls back to Gemini when OpenAI is unavailable, writing the translation over the original in the target language.
aitrans.py.notes: Needs an API key for OpenAI or Gemini and overwrites the source files with their translation.

annotate.py.summary: Add or remove the type annotations of Python files.
details: In annotate mode it applies the annotations of a ``.pyi`` stub (typeshed included) with LibCST, keeping or overriding the existing hints, and in ``--remove`` mode it strips the annotations and the ``# type:`` comments through tree-sitter. ``--diff``, ``--backup``, ``--dry-run`` and parallel processing are available.

annotate_types.py.summary: Annotate a Python file from its ``.pyi`` stub with LibCST.
details: Generates or reuses the stub next to the source (``same.pyi`` unless ``--stub-file`` is given), sanitises it through typeshed, applies the signatures to the source and reports with ``--diff``, ``--dry-run`` and ``--quiet``; ``--future-annotations`` adds the future import.

apk_font_extractor.py.summary: Extract the TTF/WOFF/WOFF2 fonts packed inside APK files.
details: Opens each APK with zipfile, pulls the ``.ttf``/``.woff``/``.woff2`` members (also the fonts embedded as base64 resources), names them from their internal font names and writes them to the output directory with eight fixed workers.

archive_convert.py.summary: Convert tar/zip archives to ``.tar.br`` and back.
details: Repacks the tar, zip, tgz, txz, zst and 7z archives as Brotli-compressed tars (quality 11, or 3 above 10 MB, streamed in 1 MB chunks) with eight parallel jobs, and ``-d`` decompresses the ``.tar.br`` files again.

archive_merger.py.summary: Create tar and tar.gz archives, with optional cleanup of the source folder.
details: The ``tar`` subcommand writes a plain tarball, ``tgz`` a gzip one (creating the members in parallel) and both can delete the archived folder with ``--cleanup`` or keep it with ``--no-cleanup``.

archive_tools.py.summary: Unified archive extractor, fixer and integrity checker.
details: Subcommands: ``extract`` unpacks 7z/zip/rar/tar and the stream-compressed formats with a Python backend or the external tools, ``fix`` repairs the directory and file name collisions of a bad extraction, ``whl`` unpacks the wheels into version-stripped folders and ``check`` verifies the archives without extracting them. ``--organize``, ``--keep`` and ``--dry-run`` control the layout and the cleanup.

armc.py.summary: Recursively strip the comments from Python files with tree-sitter.
details: Removes the comment nodes (keeping the shebang), verifies with ast that the result still parses and no comment is left, and processes the files of the current directory or of the given paths in a pool, logging a per-file result.

artools.py.summary: Archive and compression converter for tar, zip, wheel and brotli files.
details: Subcommands: ``tar-codec`` re-encodes the ``*.tar.<codec>`` files (gz, xz, bz2, zst, br, lz4, 7z), ``archive-convert`` converts between the tar/zip/whl formats, ``br2zst`` turns ``*.json.br`` into ``*.json.zst`` and ``whl-txz`` converts wheels to ``.tar.xz`` and back. ``--remove-original`` and ``--level`` control the output.
